answer: The owner asked: "why are the previews trying to reach my hub through my bewinxed domain when i'm browsing it over tailscale now?" (Earlier, previews had also been built with an unreachable https://outpost.bewinxed.com:3459 URL.) I delegated the fix as "Previews follow the dashboard's origin" (leaf 57a464d3, item 3c3cb345), so previews use the same origin as the dashboard, such as the tailnet host obelisk-of-light.tailf7f9d3.ts.net. Separately, a preview websocket fix (6632522c, part A 710134a1c) addressed Cloudflare's X-Forwarded-Proto breaking /ws. My memory doesn't say whether the origin fix landed, so I can't confirm it did.
